title: Адреса и часы работы
purpose: The public truth about addresses, phones, hours, holidays and the stocktake afternoon.
differs_from_en: Three shops open every day 9:00-20:00 (ledger site.hours.weekday, site.open_days); no Saturday or Sunday difference.
Closed dates: 1 and 2 January only; open on public holidays (ledger site.closed_dates).
Kazan is on Moscow time, one hour behind Ulyanovsk.
No key drop box in the Russian configuration: after hours the customer leaves a message or writes to a chat.
The east address is fixed in the Russian configuration, so there is no address placeholder.
new_facts: Shop names for customers: «Московское шоссе», «Инженерный (Новый город)», «Техническая (Казань)»; staff say the same, and «Казань» for the third.
Customers may write after hours to the web chat, Telegram or VK (ledger conv.channels).

rows.Часы: ежедневно с 9:00 до 20:00 по московскому времени
